request.query: Prior studies using the UCI Wine Quality data or related blinded sensory wine evaluations that specifically estimate an alcohol by residual sugar interaction for sensory quality, including outcome scale, wine-color stratification, and independent sampling unit.
request.missing_relation: Whether the proposed alcohol-by-residual_sugar interaction and within-color sensory contrast have already been directly examined, and how closely prior estimands match this one.
request.change_if_found: If a close prior analysis exists, narrow the question to a prespecified color-specific difference or a stronger independent-lot sensory design; if not, retain it only as a candidate extension, not a verified novel finding.
